name: Drill Girl
description:
About This Game

SOMEONE RUINED REMI'S BIRTHDAY

Some evil birds stole Remi's birthday balloons. All six of them! Now they're floating somewhere across the candy skyline, and you gotta catch find 'em all! Grab your spring-drill, point it down and get ready to launch up.




DRILL DOWN TO LAUNCH UP

It's all one button. Drill into the ground, build up that momentum and launch yourself into the sky. Chain together drills without touching the ground to build combos, then cash them out for a huge boost upward.



SIX CANDY-COATED AREAS

Drill and launch your way through six unique areas, each one with a stolen balloon floating somewhere near the top. The syrup below you never stops rising. Hesitate too long, and you're stuck. So move quick!



HELPFUL WINGS

Some evil jerks birds stole Remi's balloons. While others actually want to help. Find helpful birds during your run to make the climb a little easier. Mine ores along the way to fuel your path upwards.



ONLY ONE MORE RUN...

Every run, you slowly master your movements and climb a little higher than before. Restarts are almost instant, so you're straight back in the thick of it! Be careful, You can fall down the very holes you drilled to launch up!


FEATURES:

  • Drill down to launch up: One button, a forgiving start, and no limit to how high you can climb.

  • Chain combos: Mine nodes without touching the ground, then cash them out for huge boosts upward.

  • Outrun the rising syrup: It never stops coming, so don't stop climbing!

  • Helpful birds: Find birds during your run that make the journey up easier.

  • Permanent destruction: Every hole you drill stays, so plan your path carefully.

  • Quick restarts: Practically no downtime between runs.

  • Six candy-coated areas to climb, each with a stolen balloon to find.

  • Hand-made pixel art and music, with crunchy, satisfying sound effects.
short_desc: Drill down to climb up! Bounce off candy crystals, chain combos, and outrun the rising syrup to win back the birthday balloons the birds stole.
